extracted.intended_audience: prospective applicants to the DOE Computational Science Graduate Fellowship (CSGF)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and procedural requirements for applying to the DOE Computational Science Graduate Fellowship, including required supporting materials, submission process, and post-submission obligations. Covers program of study, references, transcripts, status checks, and privacy rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility to apply
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates who meet the fellowship's eligibility requirements have the option to apply to one of the DOE CSGF tracks: Science & Engineering or Math/Computer Science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility is a prerequisite to apply; the page references eligibility but does not list the specific eligibility criteria—applicants must confirm they meet the fellowship's eligibility requirements before applying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application structure and workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: Both tracks are composed of 16 individual sections which can be completed in any order and over multiple visits to the secure online portal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A checklist is incorporated for tracking progress and there is a mechanism to track the status of reference letter submissions, transcripts, etc.; applicants may complete sections in any sequence and save progress across visits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program of Study (POS) requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Generate your POS with your graduate advisor's assistance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Senior undergraduates and others matriculating into graduate school: If a graduate advisor at your preferred institution is unavailable or unable to review your POS, ask your current (or most recent) advisor to help generate the course plan. If chosen for a fellowship, both you and your Ph.D. advisor will be asked to sign and return the POS to Krell.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference letters (number and submission process)
rubrics_metrics.description: List three individuals who can speak to your character, qualifications and accomplishments in the context of the DOE CSGF application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once you list contacts, follow system prompts to notify each so they receive an automated email with letter particulars and a token-based link to upload the document and associate it with your application. It is the applicant's responsibility to ensure timely submission; applicants are encouraged to follow up with each contact directly after initiating notification via the online system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transcripts (official transcripts requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Request an official transcript from each university or college you have attended, including your current fall transcript if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transcripts sent by an applicant will not be accepted regardless of delivery method. Applicants must arrange for institutions to send official transcripts directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission confirmation and saving records
rubrics_metrics.description: You will receive an email confirming your application has been submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you do not receive a confirmation email within 24 hours, contact the program. Applicants are encouraged to save a copy of the completed application for ongoing reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lawful permanent resident (Green Card) documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are a lawful permanent resident (LPR) of the United States, Krell staff will contact you to request a copy of the front and back of your Green Card via secure submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Respond promptly to the post-submission email requesting Green Card documentation when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application status, deadlines, and outstanding materials
rubrics_metrics.description: You can check the status of your application via the online system at any time, even after final submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It is the applicant's responsibility to finalize submission by the stated deadline. Krell Institute will continue to accept transcripts and reference letters as noted; log into your application to check the status of received/outstanding documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy and disposition of application materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Application information will be used solely for the purpose of selecting fellows and administering the program and will be considered confidential as described in the Krell Institute Fellowship Privacy Statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants are responsible for reading and understanding the privacy policy. All applications from students who do not receive funding are destroyed after the selection and award acceptance period.
